stories.story_fr: Intesa Sanpaolo génère une profitabilité durable avec un résultat net de 2,8 milliards d’euros, en hausse de 5,6 % sur le même trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: Intesa Sanpaolo is able to generate solid sustainable profitability, with a net income of €2.8 billion (+5.6% on Q1 2025).
stories.quote: Intesa Sanpaolo is able to generate solid sustainable profitability, with a net income of €2.8 billion (+5.6% on Q1 2025).

stories.story_fr: Un retour de trésorerie de 2,6 milliards d’euros a été accumulé au premier trimestre 2026, dont 2,1 milliards d’euros sous forme de dividendes.
stories.story_en: Significant cash return to shareholders: €2.6 billion accrued in Q1 2026 for distribution, of which €2.1 billion as dividends.
stories.quote: Significant cash return to shareholders: €2.6 billion accrued in Q1 2026 for distribution, of which €2.1 billion as dividends...

stories.story_fr: Le groupe a généré 1,8 milliard d’euros de taxes au premier trimestre 2026.
L’inclusion financière a été renforcée avec environ 1,4 milliard d’euros de prêts sociaux distribués au T1 2026.
stories.story_en: Financial inclusion was strengthened with around €1.4 billion of social lending disbursed in Q1 2026.
stories.quote: Financial inclusion was strengthened with around €1.4 billion of social lending disbursed in Q1 2026.

stories.story_fr: Le groupe a accordé environ 13 milliards d’euros de nouveaux prêts à moyen/long terme aux ménages et entreprises italiennes au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: In Q1 2026, medium/long-term new lending disbursed by the group to Italian households and businesses amounted to around €13 billion.
stories.quote: In Q1 2026, medium/long-term new lending disbursed by the group to Italian households and businesses amounted to around €13 billion.
